meta.title: Features
meta.description: How Vink turns any PDF, typed, scanned or handwritten, into clean data for your systems: upload or email it in, AI document data extraction into your own fields, you check only what's unsure, and approved data goes out as JSON.

hero.title: Everything between the PDF and your system.
hero.lede: This is how Vink takes over the retyping. Watch one document go through, then open each step.

video.caption: One PDF in, clean data out.
video.label: A 30-second film: a handwritten work order goes into Vink and comes out as clean data.

arrives.label: It arrives
arrives.title: Getting documents in.
arrives.lede: Upload a stack or email them in. Any PDF, typed, scanned or handwritten.

reads.label: Vink reads it
reads.title: Your fields, filled from the page.
reads.lede: You say once what you need. Vink finds it on every document, whatever the layout.

check.label: You check
check.title: You only check what's unsure.
check.lede: Vink flags what it isn't sure about. Nothing is sent until someone approves it.

lands.label: It lands
lands.title: Straight into your systems.
lands.lede: Approved data goes to your system as clean JSON, keyed by your own fields.

around.label: Around it
around.title: For the whole team.
around.lede: Everyone who handles the documents, on every plan.

intake.title: Upload it or email it in.
intake.text: Drag in several PDFs at once, or give a Form its own email address and let suppliers, scanners or other systems send documents straight in.
bullets: Several PDFs in one go, each with its own progress and errors
One email address per Form, switched on by an Admin
Recent emails shows what came in, and what was refused and why
PDFs up to 10 MB and 20 pages each
intake.alt: The upload dialog with three PDFs, one of them refused for having more than 20 pages, next to a Form's email address and its recent emails.

anyPdf.title: Even scanned or filled in by hand.
anyPdf.text: Typed, scanned, faxed or filled in by hand; one page or a bundle of papers. All pages of a document fill one set of values.
bullets: Handwriting, stamps and crossed-out numbers
Tables become lists: one entry per invoice line or order line
No template per layout: a new supplier's invoice just works
anyPdf.alt: Four documents: a typed invoice, a scanned two-page delivery note, a handwritten service request and a faxed order form.

fields.title: Your fields, not a template.
fields.text: Describe the fields you need in plain words, or upload one sample PDF and Vink proposes them. You edit them, then save.
bullets: Text, number, date, yes/no, choice and list fields
A short description per field guides the reading
Change a Form any time; each Document keeps the version it came in with
fields.alt: The Form editor for Invoices with six fields, one of them a list, and the option to propose fields from a sample PDF.

source.title: Every value, with its source.
source.text: Each value shows the text as it was read and the page it came from. Click it and the PDF turns to that page.
bullets: “Read on page N” next to every value
A confidence on every value, from 0 to 1
Conflicting readings are shown, not guessed away
source.alt: The review screen for a demo invoice: the page on the left, and every field on the right with what was read, on which page, and its confidence.

review.title: Check only what's flagged.
review.text: Vink flags a value when it's unsure, when it doesn't fit the field, when a required value is missing, or when two readings disagree. Confirm it or type the right value.
bullets: A Review Threshold per Form, 0.80 by default
The reason next to every flag
Your corrections are never overwritten
review.alt: A demo delivery note with two values in Needs Review, each with its reason and a button to confirm it.

approve.title: Nothing is sent without approval.
approve.text: Someone on your team approves each Document before it's sent. For Forms you trust, switch on Auto-Send: a Document then goes out by itself, but only when nothing on it needs review.
bullets: Approve, or reject a blank or wrong document with a reason
Auto-Send is set per Form, and off until you switch it on
Every Approval records who and when
approve.alt: The Approved tab of the Documents page: an invoice approved by hand and a receipt sent by Auto-Send.

demo.title: This morning's documents. Clear them.
demo.text: Five documents came in, and one was already approved automatically. Open the others, check what Vink flagged, and approve. This is the app itself, with demo data.
demo.hint: Click a value to turn to its page. Works on your phone too.

deliver.title: Your system gets clean JSON.
deliver.text: Approved data goes out keyed by your own fields. Your developer connects one webhook, or we build the connection for you.
bullets: Signed requests, automatic retries, send again by hand
Test-send before you go live
One Integration can serve several Forms
deliver.alt: An Integration called Orders API with its recent Deliveries: delivered, delivered, retrying.

team.title: Your whole team. No seat count.
team.text: Invite colleagues as Admin or Member. Admins set up Forms and Integrations; Members upload, check and approve.
bullets: Unlimited users on every plan
Several Organisations under one login
Each Organisation's data is kept apart
team.alt: The Members page with three people and a pending invitation.

plans.title: Every plan includes everything.
plans.text: You only choose how many pages. Start with 20 free pages, no credit card.
